text:
𝗛𝗔𝗥𝗠𝗘𝗥 𝟲/𝟱𝟭, 𝗦𝗔 𝗪𝗜𝗡! 🇿🇦🔥

South Africa beat Bangladesh by 9 wickets at the Wanderers.
Harmer took 6/51; Rabada had 8 wickets in the match.

Proteas go 1-0 up. 👇
#SAvBAN #Cricket

𝗛𝗔𝗥𝗠𝗘𝗥 𝗞𝗔 𝟲/𝟱𝟭, 𝗦𝗔 𝗞𝗜 𝗝𝗔𝗜𝗝𝗔𝗜𝗞𝗔𝗔𝗥! 🇿🇦🔥

👉 South Africa ne Wanderers mein Bangladesh ko 9 wicket se haraya
👉 Simon Harmer ne doosri pari mein 6/51 liye
👉 Rabada ne match mein 8 wicket jhatke
👉 Marques Ackerman ka 157 pehla Test shatak tha

Kya Proteas ye form series mein banaye rakhenge? Comment karo 👇
